content.caseIdentity: V. Senthil Balaji v. State, (2024) 3 SCC 51
content.holding: Questioned the absolute rigidity of Anupam Kulkarni, observing that suspects should not be permitted to defeat custodial interrogation by seeking hospital admission during the first 15 days. This reasoning inspired the legislative reformulation of Section 187(2) BNSS.
content.relevance: Judicial catalyst for the expanded 40/60-day police custody window under Section 187(2) BNSS.
